import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
religion_counts_query = """
SELECT
    t1.State,
    t2.Religions,
    COUNT(*) as PatientCount
FROM
    table_3586b23a0be349f88985d8c0d783b36d t2
JOIN
    table_bd4f8d5ffa8239c09831e5b997bc2753 t1
ON
    t1.IDOrganisation = t2.IDOrganisation
GROUP BY
    t1.State, t2.Religions
ORDER BY
    t1.State, PatientCount DESC
"""
religion_counts_df = execute_sql_query(religion_counts_query)
top_religions = religion_counts_df.groupby('Religions')['PatientCount'].sum().nlargest(5).index.tolist()
top_religions_per_state = religion_counts_df.groupby('State').apply(lambda x: x.nlargest(3, 'PatientCount')['Religions'].tolist()).to_dict()
filtered_df = religion_counts_df[religion_counts_df['Religions'].isin(top_religions)]
pivot_df = filtered_df.pivot(index='State', columns='Religions', values='PatientCount').fillna(0)
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(top_religions))
ax = pivot_df[top_religions].plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, color=colors, figsize=(14, 8))
plt.title('Top 5 Religions by Patient Count Across States', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('State', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Patient Count', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Religions', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
for i, state in enumerate(pivot_df.index):
    top3 = top_religions_per_state.get(state, [])
    for j, religion in enumerate(top3):
        if religion in top_religions:
            count = pivot_df.loc[state, religion]
            if count > 0:
                y_pos = pivot_df.loc[state, top_religions[:top_religions.index(religion)]].sum() + count / 2
                ax.text(i, y_pos, f'{religion}\n{count}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
chart_path = 'exports\\charts\\temp_chart_02e3780e-1a9b-46ce-abbf-724c288c6428.png'
